mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-effective-formatting.test.ts:effective run formatting executes 25 saved outcomes and read-only refusals
outcomes: The wrapper asserts no acceptance failures and exactly 25 passed cases.

The pinned helper checks effective flag pairs, text, first-run style chains and implicit bold provenance, complete bold transitions for toggle-chain, the last bold contribution for direct-off, and result equality after reopen.
The helper checks unchanged archive bytes, paragraph identity and document version for positive rows; refusal rows check a DOCX error and unchanged archive bytes.
gaps: The wrapper aggregates helper outcomes; not every property or contribution is independently asserted for every row.
Reopen result equality alone is not an independent expected-value oracle; italic contribution details and runIndex values lack explicit expected assertions here.
Runtime leaf expansion is not measured; no rendering agreement is implied.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-effective-formatting.test.ts:defaults combine with style toggles and provenance records every transition
outcomes: Both effective flag values are asserted as true/false and the full bold contribution list checks implicit, document-default, Base and Child transitions.
gaps: The canonical defaults and toggle-chain rows are separate; no exact row combines them.
Full italic provenance, byte custody and post-inspection save/reopen are not asserted in this declaration.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-effective-formatting.test.ts:an explicit style chain does not also apply the default paragraph style
outcomes: An explicit Child chain remains Base/Child with true/true flags despite a default paragraph style supplying italic.
gaps: Canonical rows do not combine an explicit style and a separately defined default style.
This declaration checks values and chain only, not complete contributions or post-inspection save/reopen.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-effective-formatting.test.ts:inspection returns detached results and never invalidates a captured text span
outcomes: Mutating returned bold and chain data does not affect a fresh bold value or chain; the document version remains unchanged.
A span captured before inspection remains usable to replace text, which reopens as Changed.
gaps: No canonical row mutates result objects or replaces a pre-inspection captured span.
Although the test mutates an italic contribution, it does not assert that the next italic contribution is detached; no complete nested-result isolation claim.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-effective-formatting.test.ts:style definitions are read live while raw main-document edits make handles stale
outcomes: A raw live style change produces false bold without further archive changes.
After raw main-document alteration, the retained paragraph inspection throws a stale error and preserves the altered archive.
gaps: The canonical stale-paragraph row uses wrapper mutation rather than raw package changes; live style refresh lacks a row.
The declaration does not save/reopen after either raw mutation.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-effective-formatting.test.ts:UTF16 LE and BE preserve encoding/BOM and inspect reopened style definitions
outcomes: For both byte orders the reopened result is bold, inspection preserves archive bytes, and document/style parts retain the expected BOM.
gaps: Canonical rows lack UTF-16 variants; nested body loops remain unexpanded into measured runtime leaves.
The XML declaration is constructed but not separately asserted after inspection; italic and full provenance are not asserted here.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-effective-formatting.test.ts:selected ancestry refuses missing bases, links, wrong namespaces and duplicate property containers
outcomes: Six source-defined mutations of selected ancestry or properties throw and preserve exact archive bytes.
gaps: Canonical rows do not enumerate these missing-base, linked-style, namespace, property-container and uppercase-on/off variants exactly.
The dynamic callback loop is not a measured leaf inventory; generic toThrow does not establish a specific refusal code for each variant.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-effective-formatting.test.ts:unselected style ancestry is not evaluated but registry IDs remain unambiguous
outcomes: An unrelated cyclic style with a malformed bold value does not prevent resolving the selected Base/Child chain.
gaps: The title mentions registry uniqueness, but this declaration does not create duplicate IDs or assert ambiguity rejection.
Unused ancestry has no canonical row; flags, contributions and byte custody are not independently asserted here.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-effective-formatting.test.ts:protected documents remain readable without changing settings or paragraph handles
outcomes: A protected document still resolves bold true and inspection preserves the complete archive including settings.
gaps: The declaration does not capture and compare paragraph handle identity despite its title.
Canonical rows lack protected read-only inspection; no broad protection capability or save equivalence is inferred.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-effective-formatting.test.ts:disk save and reopen produce identical effective run formatting
outcomes: A multiple-run document saved to disk and reopened returns the same complete inspection array as before saving.
gaps: The expected array is produced by the same inspector, so equality is preservation evidence rather than an independent cascade oracle.
Canonical multiple-runs reopens archive bytes, not a disk path; no exact transport row exists.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-effective-formatting.test.ts:complex-script text and unsupported property contexts refuse rather than guess flags
outcomes: Hebrew text, rtl, bidi and bCs source mutations each throw with archive bytes unchanged.
gaps: The canonical complex-script row uses cs rather than these four inputs.
Body-loop leaves and specific refusal codes are not measured/asserted; this is not exhaustive script coverage.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-effective-formatting.test.ts:raw root relationship changes cannot repoint the document behind a formatting handle
outcomes: Repointing the office-document relationship behind a retained paragraph causes inspection to throw without further archive changes.
gaps: Canonical stale-paragraph refers to wrapper mutation, not raw root relationship retargeting.
The test does not assert an exact refusal code or post-refusal handle usability.
